Myopic foresight: remove existing assets with a fixed capacity from a planning horizon once ``build_year + lifetime`` lies before it (``add_brownfield``).

Fill a missing decommissioning year of a power plant with its commissioning year plus the technology lifetime (``build_powerplants``, ``add_electricity``). With ``false`` only the retirement years reported by the data sources apply and plants without one get an infinite lifetime, i.e. they are never retired; dated plants are then grouped by their retirement year as well (``<bus> <carrier>-<grouping year>-<retirement year>``).
